results.title: Caring Village of Davie - March 2026 Pricing (UPDATED)
results.snippet: This community does not offer a level of care outside of assisted living. Care can be provided for Spanish-speaking residents. Costs at this community start at $1,800 and range up to $7,604. The average price in the community is $4,702, which is equal to the average price in the area of $4,702.

results.title: Caring Village of Margate - August 2026 Pricing (UPDATED)
results.snippet: Although detailed rent figures are not provided in the available information, reviewers mention that the community has been within budget for some families, and that Medicaid is accepted; any specific costs would depend on apartment choice and the level of care required. Amenities at Caring Village of Margate focus on giving residents practical spaces to spend time outside their rooms and to support day-to-day comfort.
